# import

Import data from a ZIP file into Dataverse

## Usage

```
ppds data import [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bypass-flows` |  | `bool` |  | Bypass Power Automate flow triggers (no special privilege required) |
| `--bypass-plugins` |  | `string` |  | Bypass custom plugin execution: sync, async, or all (requires prvBypassCustomBusinessLogic privilege) |
| `--continue-on-error` |  | `bool` |  | Continue import on individual record failures |
| `--data` | `-d` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to data.zip file |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Enable diagnostic logging output |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--error-report` |  | `FileInfo` |  | Base path for output files (creates .errors.jsonl, .progress.log, .summary.json). Errors are streamed in real-time. |
| `--impersonate-owners` |  | `bool` |  | Preserve record ownership via CallerAADObjectId impersonation (requires --user-mapping) |
| `--mode` | `-m` | `ImportMode` |  | Import mode: Create, Update, or Upsert |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Profile name(s). For high-throughput pooling, specify multiple Application User profiles comma-separated (e.g., app1,app2,app3) - each profile multiplies API quota. |
| `--resolve-lookups` |  | `bool` |  | Enable external lookup resolution (ID check, then name-based query) |
| `--skip-missing-columns` |  | `bool` |  | Skip columns that exist in exported data but not in target environment (prevents schema mismatch errors) |
| `--skip-unresolved-lookups` |  | `bool` |  | Null unresolved lookups instead of failing the record [default: True] (requires --resolve-lookups) |
| `--strip-owner-fields` |  | `bool` |  | Strip ownership fields (ownerid, createdby, modifiedby) allowing Dataverse to assign current user |
| `--user-mapping` | `-u` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to user mapping XML file for remapping user references |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Enable verbose logging output |
